test_fetch_first_next_variants: test the SQL FETCH FIRST and FETCH NEXT clauses with ORDER BY and OFFSET
test_fetch_with_where_clause: test the SQL FETCH clause combined with WHERE filter conditions
test_fetch_with_group_by: test the SQL FETCH clause after GROUP BY with aggregation and ORDER BY
test_fetch_with_join: test the SQL FETCH clause with INNER JOIN across multiple tables
test_fetch_with_union: test the SQL FETCH clause on a UNION ALL subquery result set
test_fetch_errors_percent: test the SQL FETCH clause rejects unsupported PERCENT syntax with SQLInterfaceError
test_fetch_errors_with_ties: test the SQL FETCH clause rejects unsupported WITH TIES syntax with SQLInterfaceError
test_fetch_errors_limit_conflict: test the SQL query rejects combining LIMIT and FETCH clauses with SQLSyntaxError
